verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh is an AML/KYC compliance platform, so a document-plus-selfie verification flow is a fair capability to ask about. The evidence covers sanctions, PEP and adverse-media screening, case management, transaction monitoring and webhooks. None of it describes a hosted or drop-in document/selfie capture flow, server-side verification sessions, or redirect/embed capture UI.

support.subject: As a developer, I can launch a complete document-plus-selfie verification with a hosted or drop-in flow — create a session server-side, redirect or embed, and read the result — without building capture UI myself
